name: Dandong
registryBasis: Liaoning’s official provincial-government portal reports Dandong’s real-property registration center and its online application, appointment, record-query, and certificate-verification workflows. Dandong’s official natural-resources map portal identifies the Dandong Natural Resources Bureau as host. The map portal publishes generic vector/imagery/topographic/land-cover services; no cadastral parcel layer was listed.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
